description: May 25 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 25 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: May 25 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Does curiosity have a contemplative side? May 25th suggests it can. Four degrees into Gemini, in the Mercury-ruled first decan, the Sun meets 7, the number of inner enquiry and analysis. People born today are often pictured as thinkers rather than chatterboxes, collectors of questions who like to explore a topic thoroughly before offering an opinion on it.

On May 25 the Sun usually sits at about 4° Gemini, in the first decan, where Mercury rules the decan as well as the sign. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: May 25 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 25 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on May 25: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 25 is the 145th day of the year (146th in a leap year). By June 22, 28 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 25 include Ralph Waldo Emerson (1803), Pieter Zeeman (1865) and Ian McKellen (1939).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 25?
faq.answer: May 25 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 25 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 25?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 25 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 25?
faq.answer: May 25 is also the birthday of Ralph Waldo Emerson (1803), Pieter Zeeman (1865) and Ian McKellen (1939). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
